#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define ll long long
#define pb push_back
#define F first
#define S second
#define MAX 100000000000000000
#define MOD 1000000007
#define PI 3.141592653589793238462
#define INF 1000000000
using namespace std;
int find(string s1,string s2,int start){
	for (int i=start;i<s1.size();i++){
		if (s1[i]==s2[0]){
			bool f=1; 
			for (int j=i+1;j<i+s2.size();j++){
				if (s2[j-i]!=s1[j]) f=0;
			}
			if (f) return i;
		}
	}
	return -1;
}
int main(){
	string s1,s2,ans;
	bool findat=0;
	int pos;
	cin>>s1;
	pos=find(s1,"at",1);
	s2=s1.substr(0,pos)+'@'+s1.substr(pos+2);
	int i=find(s2,"dot",1),last=0;
	while(i!=-1&&i<s2.size()-3){
		ans+=s2.substr(last,i-last)+".";
		last=i+3;
		i=find(s2,"dot",last);
	}
	ans+=s2.substr(last);
	cout<<ans; 
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
